decisions.reason: A schlager compilation sits at the core of the firm's established catalog and costs almost nothing to keep listed in a growing market, so results likely meet aspirations and give no reason to search for alternatives.
The illustrated release series is a multi-model line that builds the label's curated identity, and it had a page of its own in both years, so it is likely a satisfactory, ongoing line worth carrying.
Reissued jazz vinyl fits the strategy of broadening genres and formats, and vinyl demand has been rising, though limited pressings may sell out and leave the catalog.
Multi-disc box sets are a signature, high-margin offer for collectors and are typically kept in stock until sold out, so with industry growth providing slack there is little pressure to drop it.
This compilation CD was only mentioned rather than given its own page, which suggests weaker results, but warehouse-backed catalog items are cheap to carry, so it likely stays listed.
